name: Galata Acquisition Corp. II Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Galata Acquisition Corp. II operates as a special-purpose acquisition company (SPAC), whose primary objective is to execute a business combination. Such a combination might encompass various forms of corporate integration, including outright mergers, share exchanges, or asset purchases. Its strategic focus is directed toward identifying prospective target companies within the energy, financial technology (fintech), real estate, and broader technology sectors.
